ops.body: - The road engine, step 4 (spoken turns, RE25; decision 0205), left for later: nothing is spoken with the phone locked or the app behind another, since the screen's position is read only while the app is in front (`useLiveTrace` skips while not active), so RE33 is not met: it needs the drive step and the speech run from the background location task; a turn found again after leaving the way may be spoken a second time (it is told apart by where it is along the way, which changes with the new way); the voice, its language and its rate are the phone's defaults, and speech does not lower or pause other audio by any choice of ours; "End" and the mute are taps on a moving screen.

- Spoken turns and guiding on a phone (RE25, RE33; decision 0205; `roads/speech.ts` over `expo-speech`, `roads/useDrive.ts`): "Drive there" is now offered on iOS and Android and has never run on either: whether a turn is heard at all, over music or a call, through CarPlay or Bluetooth; whether it is spoken once; the mute; and that nothing is spoken once the phone is locked (known: the position is read only in front).

| The road engine (the app finds the road between towns and guides the drive: a road graph from the map's z12 tiles, one way through the journey's towns, distance by road, spoken turns; RE1-RE34, decisions 0203, 0204 and 0205) | `claude/determined-wright-yg1fq9` | steps 0 to 4 built 2026-11-18: the engine, the road on the outing page, guiding ("Drive there", the turn ahead, End), turns spoken once with a mute (expo-speech); owed: RE14 (towns by the road), road names and roundabouts, speech behind the lock screen (RE33); nothing run on a phone |
